children: On August 26, 2026, the company received a Nasdaq notice that it is not in compliance with Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) due to not filing its Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. The company has until October 26, 2026 to submit a compliance plan, and if accepted, may receive up to February 22, 2027 to regain compliance; the notice has no immediate effect on its Nasdaq listing.
